name: Instafeed Block
description: A configurable block that renders an Instagram feed client-side via the instafeed.js library.
library_dependencies: stevenschobert/instafeed.js (2.0.0) — external JS library, installed at /libraries/instafeed.js/dist/instafeed.min.js

suggests.stevenschobert/instafeed.js: The instafeed.js library is required to use the drupal/instafeed_block module.

project_description:
Provides customizable blocks to display Instagram posts that can be placed in any region of your website.

 It integrates the instafeed.js library into your Drupal website, allowing you to display an Instagram feed seamlessly. Additionally, it provides functionality to automatically refresh the Instagram access token before it expires, ensuring uninterrupted access to your Instagram content.

 The 2.x branch raises the core requirement to ^10.1 || ^11 || ^12 and moves hook implementations to an OOP hook class (src/Hook/InstafeedBlockHooks.php) registered as an autowired service, with #[LegacyHook] wrappers retained in the .module file. Block configuration, State-based token storage, and the cron token refresh are unchanged from 1.x.
